_comment: Tool roles of the RTL flow (docs/spec/rtl-flow.md): Verible (open source). `q3tui tools init` copies them into the project's config/tools.json, where they are yours to edit; `lint`, `synth`, `sim`, `run` come from the synopsys preset. verible_lint exits 1 when it finds something: that is a result, not a failure.

verible_lint.description: Verible style / lint check of the RTL files with the flags Q3TUI wrote from the rules (src/rtl/style_lint/verible.flags)

csr_gen.description: APB-CSR-Generator (https://github.com/nguyenquanicd/APB-CSR-Generator): reads the register-map workbook, writes RTL/<module>.sv, RTL/models/m_vlsi_synch.sv and Debug/debug.json into its working directory. {python} is Q3TUI's interpreter (it has openpyxl); {tool} is the generator's folder

verible_format.description: Verible formatter; --inplace rewrites the files (whitespace only)
